title: Triple VecDeque return type from load_messages_for_chat is still positional
description: kith-tui/src/event.rs:308: load_messages_for_chat returns (VecDeque<String>, VecDeque<String>, VecDeque<String>) with meaning documented only in a comment. All six call sites unpack by positional convention; the compiler cannot enforce ordering. The same reasoning that justified MessageEntry (replacing an opaque tuple) applies here. A named return struct (LoadedMessages { display_lines, message_ids, sender_ids }) removes the positional footgun at the function boundary.
